title: Bradford Protein Concentration Determination
author: Brian Baltzar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.girbud6

steps.title: Prepare BSA standards
steps.instruction: Dilute bovine serum albumin (BSA) according to the provided table to generate the standard concentration series.

steps.title: Prepare diluted Bradford reagent
steps.instruction: Dilute the Bio‑Rad Bradford Protein Assay 5X stock to the working concentration as instructed (typically to 1X).

steps.title: Add Bradford reagent to samples
steps.instruction: Add 1.4 mL of the diluted Bradford reagent to each diluted BSA standard tube and to each tube containing 30 µL of the protein sample of interest.

steps.title: Mix reaction
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube for 10 seconds to ensure thorough mixing.

steps.title: Incubate color development
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at room temperature for 30 minutes (do not exceed 1 hour).

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of each tube at 595 nm using a spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Generate standard curve
steps.instruction: Plot the optical density (OD) values of the BSA standards (OD on the Y‑axis, known BSA concentrations on the X‑axis) to create a calibration curve.

steps.title: Determine unknown concentration
steps.instruction: Use the standard curve to calculate the concentration of the protein of interest from its measured absorbance.
